mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, reducing metabolism of norepinephrine, while candesartan causes vasodilation and may potentiate sympathomimetic effects, creating risk for hypertensive crisis and additive cardiovascular effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution and close blood pressure monitoring; consider alternative antidepressant or antihypertensive agent.
